# NewVacancyAlert.in

NewVacancyAlert.in is a high-speed, interactive visual dashboard and unified repository for verified Indian central and state government job notifications, admit cards, exam results, and academic timelines.

## Core Services

- **Unified Job Board**: Multi-column real-time filtering by category (Technical, Banking, Defense, Railway, Education, Medical) and active search query parameters.
- **Detailed Directives**: Each job has a dedicated detail page detailing exact age limits, relaxation matrices, academic qualification rules, selection stages, step-by-step dispatch guidelines, required dossiers, and direct official PDF source references.
- **Verification Engine**: 100% human-verified source notices with explicit red-alert warnings, yellow caution tips, and green general advisories to prevent candidate application errors.

## Site Map & Key URIs

- **Home Dashboard**: `https://newvacancyalert.in/` - Main repository with multi-attribute live list sorting (post counts, date published, deadlines).
- **Search System**: `https://newvacancyalert.in/?q={search_term}` - Real-time keyword filter query parameter.
- **Individual Job Entries**: `/vssc-apprentice-recruitment-2026`, `/indian-army-sscw-tech-68`, `/rites-am-mechanical-2026`, etc.

## Data Schema & Entities

Each recruitment notification contains structured parameters including:
- `board`: Recruiting Government Authority or Organization.
- `title`: Standard post names and total vacancy count.
- `advtNo`: Official Advertisement Reference Number.
- `vacancies`: Quantified active training/job positions.
- `jobLocation`: Regional station or headquarters.
- `applicationMode`: Online, Walk-In selection, or Offline postal dispatch.
- `eligibility`: Education requirements, exact age limits, and medical fitness parameters.
- `salary`: Consolidated pay scales or monthly stipend values.
- `faqs`: 10-30 verified question-and-answer pairs per job post.
